subject: prd/e2e-verification
statement: The dogfood's e2e design doc carries a stated answer under every FR-19 element — or an existing harness cited with only its delta (FR-20) — with the buildability lens returning no finding against it, and the plan cut from it names one exclusively-owned artifact per scenario task with no artifact named twice
fit_criterion: the dogfood design doc, the well-formedness checker's clean result over its harness section, the buildability lens's finding-free verdict, and the plan's per-task owned-artifact list
